items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: Like Charlie Parker came up and played some with us.

ctx.x: Oh, Ernestine Anderson worked. Jimmy Scott, and I had a short period...Sonny Parker, before he passed, he was with it for a lot of years. And also, I got there just in the tail end of Winnie Brown, I think her name was. Her name was Winnie Brown. She made the "Midnight Sun" thing kind of popular.

Anyhow, as I was saying about the time we worked the Band Box, there'd be occasions on our first set we'd played, before Hamp came out, if somebody was in the audience, a player. would come and set in with us. Like Bud Powell came up, oh yeah. Like Charlie Parker came up and played some with us.
